Today, we’re joined by political commentator and co-host of The Verdict with Ted Cruz, Ben Ferguson!

Here’s what’s on the agenda:

Democrats won control of both the House and Senate, flipped Senate seats in states Donald Trump won comfortably two years ago, and broke through in several major governor’s races. The biggest question today is not just what happened, it is why?

Not only that, but what will Republicans do with the message voters just sent them? Do Democrats actually understand what voters were voting for? Democrats have now flipped at least seven Republican-held Senate seats: Texas, Kansas, Iowa, Ohio, Maine, North Carolina and South Carolina. They also won the House majority, although the final size of that majority is still being determined.

We’re going to look at some of the biggest results from last night before turning to you guys to answer your questions and see what you think of the results. 

Finally, we’ll take a look at the road ahead. We’ll discuss a few Democratic Governors who all won their reelection campaigns and look like strong candidates for 2028. We’ll also talk about about what the current administration moving forward means for the Republican party heading in to 2028.
